originalEntry.title: Glass and gold mosaic that comes alive
originalEntry.title_zh: 会飞起来的玻璃金箔马赛克
originalEntry.author: LCSlates
originalEntry.description: An 80-second square WebGL2 film of a glass and gold-leaf mosaic whose tiles lift, flock into a fish, cranes and stars, then click back, with browser-synthesized sound.
originalEntry.description_zh: 80 秒方形 WebGL2 短片：玻璃金箔马赛克的瓷片飞起，聚成鱼、仙鹤和星座，再咔嗒归位，声音在浏览器里合成。
originalEntry.prompt: Make an 80 second square animated film as a single HTML file, using WebGL2 and plain JavaScript, with no libraries and no image, font or audio files. It should look like a glass and gold leaf wall mosaic whose tiles were never glued down, so they can lift, flip, fly and click back into place. Figures are flocks of tiles, so a fish swims by its tiles swimming
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 用 WebGL2 和纯 JavaScript 做一部 80 秒的方形动画短片，做成单个 HTML 文件，不用任何库，也不用图片、字体或音频文件。它看起来要像一面玻璃和金箔拼成的墙面马赛克，瓷片从来没被粘牢，所以它们可以掀起、翻转、飞走，再咔嗒一声落回原位。图形由成群的瓷片组成，所以一条鱼游动，靠的是它的瓷片在游动
